description: Introduction — welcome, battlefield grid, and the three Progeny.

steps.speaker: Tutorial
steps.text: Welcome Commander, to Tactica: A Space Opera.Your goal is to conquer this frontier sector and control its BISMUTH.

steps.speaker: Tutorial
steps.text: Battles are fought on a grid of squares. Positioning, unit matchups, and terrain decide who wins.

steps.speaker: Tutorial
steps.text: Three PROGENY fight for the BISMUTH:◦ Ertrians — human colonists powered by trade and industry.◦ Virix — a hive that grows where BISMUTH burns hot.◦ Sentus — a holy monarchy strengthened near sacred nodes.Each faction produces and fights differently. Universal tactics come first.
